object_description: compact four-story building with a tree-shaped geometric cut
design_condition: The compact volume is placed among existing trees and across the sloping site, creating three clearly defined outdoor spaces at different levels while preserving the flowing landscape and providing access from two streets.

positive.statement: The building confidently creates a new address through its strong and independent setting.
The placement restructures the outdoor spaces in a differentiated manner, creating three spacious and clearly defined areas.
The tree population is preserved and harmoniously complemented, maintaining the image of a flowing landscape.
The clear western orientation of the group rooms creates good lighting situations.
The floor-by-floor organization successfully creates three clear functional units.
The compact four-story building is expected to be resource-efficient to construct.

negative.statement: The external stairs could prove problematic, especially in winter.
The selected layout prevents the movement spaces from being collapsed.
The themed rooms cannot operationally replace the desired collapsibility.
The exposed-concrete construction principle raises questions about the insulation perimeter.
The proposal leaves questions about accessibility and functionality.
